get.description:
Report process liveness with no dependency checks.

Returns:
    dict[str, str]: `{"status": "ok"}` whenever this handler can run.

Report dependency readiness, failing only on MongoDB.

Sets a 503 status when MongoDB is unreachable; a Redis outage is
reported but never fails readiness, per the module docstring.

Returns:
    dict[str, object]: Overall status plus a per-dependency breakdown.

post.description:
Authenticate against AD and, on success, set the session cookie.

Args:
    payload (LoginRequest): The username/password to authenticate.
    response (Response): Carries the session cookie back on success.
    service (AuthService): Runs the LDAP bind and role resolution.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the session secret, TTL and lockout limits.
    redis (RedisClientHolder): Backs the per-username failure counter.
    audit (AuditService): Records `LOGIN_SUCCEEDED` / `LOGIN_DENIED` (docs/adr/0047).

Returns:
    LoginResponse: The authenticated username and resolved role.

Raises:
    RateLimitedError: Too many recent failures for this username (429).
    UnauthorizedError: Wrong username or password.
    ForbiddenError: Valid credentials, but not admin/viewer listed.
    ServiceUnavailableError: LDAP or the AD API is unreachable.

Clear the session cookie.

Args:
    response (Response): Carries the cookie deletion back.

get.description:
Report whether login is required and, if so, who's logged in.

Args:
    request (Request): Carries the session cookie, if any.
    settings (Settings): Supplies `auth_enabled` and the session secret.

Returns:
    MeResponse: `login_required=False` (and an auto-admin identity)
        when auth is disabled; otherwise the verified cookie's identity,
        or `authenticated=False` if there isn't one.

List servers, keyset-paginated, with generic filters and search.

Every query parameter outside the fixed non-filter set is a filter key
validated against the whitelist — see the module docstring.

Args:
    request (Request): Carries the raw filter query parameters.
    repo (MongoServerRepository): The server repository.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside for the list page.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the default/max page size.
    search (str | None): Free-text search over the server's search tokens.
    sort (str): The field to sort by.
    sort_desc (bool): Sort descending instead of ascending.
    cursor (str | None): Opaque keyset cursor from a previous page.
    page_size (int | None): Page size; defaults to `settings.default_page_size`.
    with_count (bool): Whether to compute the total matching count.

Returns:
    ServerListResponse | Response: The page of servers — a raw cached
        JSON body on a cache hit (see the module docstring), the
        validated model on a miss.

Raises:
    UnknownFilterError: A query parameter isn't a recognized filter key.
    PageSizeTooLargeError: `page_size` exceeds `settings.max_page_size`.

The whole fleet as flat inventory rows, for client-side filtering (ADR-0033).

Cached as wire bytes, cleared with the list pages (ADR-0028), and
weak-ETagged so a poller whose copy is current gets a bodiless 304.

Args:
    request (Request): Carries `If-None-Match`.
    repo (MongoServerRepository): The server repository.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside for the body.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the staleness window.

Returns:
    Response: The JSON body with `ETag` and `Cache-Control: no-cache`,
        or a 304 when the client's ETag is current.

Find one or more assignable, live-verified servers for a BMH-creation caller.

Exactly one of `name`/`pattern` selects the lookup mode — see ADR-0032.

Args:
    service (AvailableServersService): Resolves both lookup modes.
    cache (CacheClient): Invalidated for every server a live recheck writes.
    settings (Settings): Supplies `max_available_count` and the NIC
        OS-name mapping for each item's `interfaces[].os_name`.
    name (str | None): Exact, case-insensitive server name.
    pattern (str | None): A MongoDB regex against `Server.name`.
    count (int | None): Pattern mode only; how many servers to return.
    vendor (Vendor | None): Restrict to one vendor.
    source_provider (ManagerType | None): Restrict to one collector.
    health (HealthSeverity | None): Restrict to exactly this tier instead
        of filling `HEALTHY` then `WARNING` then `MAJOR`. A caller that
        only provisions on `HEALTHY` hardware would otherwise be handed —
        and pay a live recheck for — a `WARNING` server whenever no
        `HEALTHY` one is free.
    min_nic_macs (int): Require this many NIC MACs, read this collection
        run. A BMH caller should pass at least 1 — a server with none
        cannot become a `BareMetalHost`, which has no `bootMACAddress`
        without one — and 2 for a bonded NMState configuration. Opt-in
        (default 0) so the endpoint's existing behaviour is unchanged.

Returns:
    AvailableServersResponse: Always list-shaped, `name` mode returning
        at most one item.

Raises:
    AvailableLookupConflictingParamsError: Neither or both of `name`/
        `pattern` were given, or `count` was given with `name`.
    AvailableCountTooLargeError: `count` exceeds `settings.max_available_count`.
    AvailableServerNameAmbiguousError: `name` matched several servers.
    AvailableServerNotFoundError: Nothing could be returned at all —
        see `AvailableServersNotFoundError`'s reason in the detail.
    ServiceUnavailableError: A vendor manager failed (timeout, login, network)
        while verifying; the detail names the manager type and the reason.

Get one server's full detail.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server's ID.
    repo (MongoServerRepository): The server repository.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside for the detail document, keyed by
        revision (see the module docstring).
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.

Returns:
    ServerDetail | Response: The server's detail — a raw cached JSON
        body on a cache hit (see `list_servers`'s docstring for why),
        the validated model on a miss.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.

post.description:
Re-run classification for one server against the current ruleset.

The same step ingestion runs, on demand. Records a
`CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED` audit event when the installation type changes.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server's ID.
    repo (MongoServerRepository): The server repository.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside to invalidate on write.
    service (ClassificationService): Runs the classification engine.
    audit (AuditService): Records the change, if any.
    actor (Actor): The actor to attribute the audit event to.
    request_id (str | None): The current request's ID, for the audit event.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.

Returns:
    ServerDetail: The server after reclassification.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.

Re-run health evaluation for one server against the current policy set.

Same rationale as `reclassify_server`. Records a `HEALTH_CHANGED`
audit event when the overall severity changes.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server's ID.
    repo (MongoServerRepository): The server repository.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside to invalidate on write.
    service (HealthPolicyService): Runs the health policy engine.
    audit (AuditService): Records the change, if any.
    actor (Actor): The actor to attribute the audit event to.
    request_id (str | None): The current request's ID, for the audit event.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.

Returns:
    ServerDetail: The server after health re-evaluation.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.

put.description:
Enable maintenance mode on a server.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server's ID.
    payload (MaintenanceEnableRequest): The reason/expected end.
    service (MaintenanceService): Applies the maintenance state change.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside to invalidate on write.
    actor (Actor): The actor to attribute the audit event to.
    request_id (str | None): The current request's ID, for the audit event.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.

Returns:
    ServerDetail: The server with maintenance enabled.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.

delete.description:
Disable maintenance mode on a server.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server's ID.
    service (MaintenanceService): Applies the maintenance state change.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside to invalidate on write.
    actor (Actor): The actor to attribute the audit event to.
    request_id (str | None): The current request's ID, for the audit event.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.

Returns:
    ServerDetail: The server with maintenance disabled.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.

post.description:
Take the install lock on a server, so no other run can draw it.

Closes the window in which two MCEs draw one machine, and is idempotent for
the same `workflow_id` — docs/adr/0035-install-reservation-lock.md.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server to lock.
    payload (ReserveServerRequest): Who is taking it, for which MCE and
        InfraEnv, and for how long.
    service (ReservationService): Applies the lock.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside to invalidate on write.
    actor (Actor): The actor to attribute the audit event to.
    request_id (str | None): The current request's ID, for the audit event.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.

Returns:
    ServerDetail: The server, now reserved.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.
    ConflictError: Another holder has a live lock on it, or won the race.

delete.description:
Release the install lock, returning the server to the pool.

A release of an unheld server succeeds; with `holder`, another holder's lock
is refused rather than stolen — ADR-0035, "Consequences".

Args:
    server_id (str): The server to release.
    service (ReservationService): Applies the release.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside to invalidate on write.
    actor (Actor): The actor to attribute the audit event to.
    request_id (str | None): The current request's ID, for the audit event.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the NIC OS-name mapping.
    payload (ReleaseServerRequest | None): Who is releasing, if anyone.

Returns:
    ServerDetail: The server, with no reservation.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No server has that ID.
    ConflictError: A live lock belongs to a different holder.

get.description:
List every classification rule, optionally filtered by enabled state.

Args:
    repo (MongoClassificationRuleRepository): The rule repository.
    enabled (bool | None): When set, restrict to enabled or disabled
        rules only; omit to return every rule.

Returns:
    ClassificationRuleListResponse: The matching rules.

Get one classification rule by ID.

Args:
    rule_id (str): The rule's ID.
    repo (MongoClassificationRuleRepository): The rule repository.

Returns:
    ClassificationRuleResponse: The matching rule.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No rule has that ID.

List every health policy, optionally filtered by enabled state.

Args:
    policy_repo (MongoHealthPolicyRepository): The health policy repository.
    enabled (bool | None): When set, restrict to enabled or disabled
        policies only; omit to return every policy.

Returns:
    HealthPolicyListResponse: The matching policies.

Get one health policy by ID.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The policy's ID.
    policy_repo (MongoHealthPolicyRepository): The health policy repository.

Returns:
    HealthPolicyResponse: The matching policy.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: No policy has that ID.

List every metric definition the health policy engine can evaluate.

Args:
    registry (MetricRegistry): The module-level metric registry.

Returns:
    HealthMetricListResponse: Every registered metric definition.

List audit events across every server, newest first, with keyset paging.

Args:
    repo (MongoAuditEventRepository): The audit event repository.
    server_id (str | None): Restrict to events for this server.
    event_type (str | None): Restrict to this event type.
    actor_id (str | None): Restrict to events recorded by this actor (exact `actor.id`).
    since (datetime | None): Only events at or after this instant (inclusive).
    until (datetime | None): Only events before this instant (exclusive).
    server_name (str | None): Case-insensitive substring of the server's name;
        matches current servers (first 5000 ids) and the name snapshotted on the
        event, so pruned servers still match.
    cursor (str | None): Opaque cursor from a previous page's response.
    page_size (int): Maximum items to return, 1-200.

Returns:
    AuditEventListResponse: The matching page of events; filters combine with AND.

List distinct event actors by `actor.id`, busiest first (at most 200).

Args:
    repo (MongoAuditEventRepository): The audit event repository.

Returns:
    EventActorListResponse: Each actor's type/display from its latest event, and its count.

List audit events for one server, newest first, with keyset paging.

Args:
    server_id (str): The server's ID.
    repo (MongoAuditEventRepository): The audit event repository.
    cursor (str | None): Opaque cursor from a previous page's response.
    page_size (int): Maximum items to return, 1-200.

Returns:
    AuditEventListResponse: The matching page of events.

List every configured site with its per-site and fleet-wide statistics.

Args:
    repo (MongoServerRepository): The server repository.
    cache (CacheClient): Cache-aside for the aggregation.
    settings (Settings): Supplies the configured site catalog.

Returns:
    SiteStatsListResponse: One record per configured site, plus
        "Unassigned", plus the fleet-wide summary across all of them.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: The principal an `AuditEvent` records as having performed it.

ActorType.title: ActorType
ActorType.description: The kind of principal that performed an audited action.

AuditEventListResponse.title: AuditEventListResponse
AuditEventListResponse.description: One page of audit events plus its paging metadata.

AuditEventResponse.title: AuditEventResponse
AuditEventResponse.description: The public representation of one audit event.

AvailableInterface.title: AvailableInterface
AvailableInterface.description:
One NIC as a BMH/NMState generator needs it: name, MAC, placement, link state.

`link_state` is what lets a caller bond only up ports — ADR-0032's
2026-09-25 update, which also records how unevenly vendors report it.

AvailableServerItem.title: AvailableServerItem
AvailableServerItem.description:
One `GET /servers/available` result — only what a BMH/NMState generator consumes.

Deliberately not `ServerDetail` (ADR-0032, 2026-09-13 update): the
caller builds a `BareMetalHost` and an `NMStateConfig`, nothing else.

BmcInfo.title: BmcInfo
BmcInfo.description: A server's baseboard management controller address, parsed into parts.

Breakdown.title: Breakdown
Breakdown.description:
The counts one slice of the fleet reports.

Shared by a whole site and by each slice within it, so the UI renders
both with one component.

Classification.title: Classification
Classification.description: The classification outcome embedded on a `Server` document.

ClassificationRuleListResponse.title: ClassificationRuleListResponse
ClassificationRuleListResponse.description: The full list of classification rules.

ClassificationRuleResponse.title: ClassificationRuleResponse
ClassificationRuleResponse.description: The public representation of one classification rule.

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description:
A single node in a health-policy condition tree.

Exactly one of `all_of`, `any_of`, `not_`, `metric` is set, enforced by a
`model_validator` rather than a tagged union nobody would want to type.

Connectivity.title: Connectivity
Connectivity.description: A server's fabric attachments plus the derived facts computed from them.

ConnectivityAttachment.title: ConnectivityAttachment
ConnectivityAttachment.description: One reported fabric attachment — a physical uplink or a vNIC carved out of one.

ConnectivityFacts.title: ConnectivityFacts
ConnectivityFacts.description:
Fabric-path scalars derived from `attachments` once at ingest and stored.

`total != up + down` is deliberate: UNKNOWN/DEGRADED counts toward neither.

ConnectivitySummary.title: ConnectivitySummary
ConnectivitySummary.description:
`ServerSummary`'s slice of `Connectivity`.

Facts only, never the full `attachments` list (that's detail-only; see
the module docstring on why summaries stay lean).

EventActor.title: EventActor
EventActor.description: One distinct actor seen in the audit log.

EventPageInfo.title: EventPageInfo
EventPageInfo.description: Keyset paging metadata for a page of audit events.

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: The closed, append-only registry of audit event kinds.

EvidenceField.title: EvidenceField
EvidenceField.description: One metric a fired policy cites as evidence, keyed for the message template.

FleetSummary.title: FleetSummary
FleetSummary.description:
Every site summed together, sliced further by installation type.

Folded server-side in `sites._pivot`, not summed from `items` by the
client, so every consumer gets the identical fleet-wide number.

Gpu.title: Gpu
Gpu.description: One GPU reported for a server.

Hardware.title: Hardware
Hardware.description: A server's complete vendor-neutral hardware inventory.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: The health rollup embedded on a `Server` document, one severity per category.

HealthMetricListResponse.title: HealthMetricListResponse
HealthMetricListResponse.description: The full list of metric definitions the health engine can evaluate.

HealthMetricResponse.title: HealthMetricResponse
HealthMetricResponse.description:
One entry in the metric registry, for a future condition-builder UI.

Carries the same fields `MetricDef` does, minus `resolver`, which is a
Python callable and has no business crossing the API boundary.

HealthPolicyListResponse.title: HealthPolicyListResponse
HealthPolicyListResponse.description: The full list of health policies.

HealthPolicyResponse.title: HealthPolicyResponse
HealthPolicyResponse.description: The public representation of one health policy.

HealthReason.title: HealthReason
HealthReason.description: One policy that fired in the last evaluation, without its evidence.

HealthSeverity.title: HealthSeverity
HealthSeverity.description:
A server's overall or per-category health, from best to worst.

Every aggregation sorts by `HEALTH_SEVERITY_RANK`. `MAJOR` is "redundancy
gone, still serving"; `INFO` was retired 2026-09-13 — docs/architecture.md.

Identity.title: Identity
Identity.description: The identity fields a server is correlated on across collector runs.

InstallationType.title: InstallationType
InstallationType.description: A server's role, as a regex verdict on its hostname (classification).

LinkState.title: LinkState
LinkState.description: A network interface's reported link state.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description: The response body for a successful `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

Maintenance.title: Maintenance
Maintenance.description: The maintenance-mode state embedded on a `Server` document.

MaintenanceEnableRequest.title: MaintenanceEnableRequest
MaintenanceEnableRequest.description: The request body for enabling maintenance mode on a server.

MaintenanceFlag.title: MaintenanceFlag
MaintenanceFlag.description: The maintenance fields an inventory row shows.

ManagerType.title: ManagerType
ManagerType.description:
How this platform reaches a server.

`REDFISH_STANDALONE` names no manager: one BMC at a time, for machines
no aggregator owns (docs/adr/0016).

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description: The response body for `GET /api/v1/auth/me` — see docs/adr/0034 for the SPA's use of it.

MediaType.title: MediaType
MediaType.description: A storage drive's reported media type.

Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: A server's aggregate memory configuration and its individual DIMMs.

MemoryModule.title: MemoryModule
MemoryModule.description: One DIMM reported for a server.

MetricType.title: MetricType
MetricType.description: The value shapes a metric can carry, used to validate operator compatibility.

NetworkInfo.title: NetworkInfo
NetworkInfo.description: A server's BMC address and its network interfaces.

NetworkInterface.title: NetworkInterface
NetworkInterface.description: One network interface reported for a server.

OpenShiftLifecycle.title: OpenShiftLifecycle
OpenShiftLifecycle.description:
One server's observed OpenShift membership.

Attributes:
    lifecycle_state (OpenShiftState): Whether the server is in use.
        `AVAILABLE` until a job claims it, and again once one stops.
    cluster_name (str | None): The cluster holding it, on `INSTALLED`.
        `None` on `AVAILABLE`, and on `INSTALLED_TO_INVENTORY`, where
        an MCE holds the server but no cluster does. The identifier of
        a cluster, on its own: names are unique across this estate,
        including across MCEs.
    mce_name (str | None): The MCE that reported it. Set by the MCE job
        only; `None` on a plain cluster node, which no MCE knows about.
    last_reported_at (datetime | None): When a job last wrote this
        membership. An unchanged membership is not rewritten, so on a
        stable cluster it does not advance: diagnostic only, never a
        liveness signal (use the `membership_runs` record, ADR-0029).
    reported_by_agent_id (str | None): Which job instance wrote this,
        for tracing a wrong value back to the cluster that reported it.
    reported_name (str | None): The hostname OpenShift reported, set
        only when it differs from `Server.name` (ADR-0036). `None`
        means the cluster's name and the inventory's agree.
    previous_reporter (str | None): The claim that held this server
        before the current one took it over (a reporter, or
        `mce/hosted-cluster` for a bound agent); `None` if nobody did.
    claim_changed_at (datetime | None): When `reported_by_agent_id`
        took it over from `previous_reporter`.
    contested_with (str | None): The other claim still on this
        server, set when ownership flipped back to `previous_reporter`
        within an hour (ADR-0041); `None` when uncontested.
    contested_name (str | None): The hostname the other claim reports for
        the server (`Server.name` when it reports no different one); `None`
        when uncontested.

OpenShiftState.title: OpenShiftState
OpenShiftState.description:
Whether a server is in use, as a cluster or MCE reports it.

Parallel to `InstallationType` (a regex verdict on the name) and
deliberately not the same thing — see docs/adr/0024, Decision 3.

PageInfo.title: PageInfo
PageInfo.description: Keyset paging metadata for a page of servers.

PolicyScope.title: PolicyScope
PolicyScope.description: The site/vendor/manager-type dimensions a health policy is scoped to.

PolicyStats.title: PolicyStats
PolicyStats.description: Runtime statistics tracked for a health policy's evaluations.

ProfileTemplate.title: ProfileTemplate
ProfileTemplate.description:
The reusable template this server's profile was provisioned from.

Vendor-neutral: `name` is the vendor's display name, `external_id` its
opaque reference. Per-vendor sources: docs/architecture.md, "The provider contract".

Psu.title: Psu
Psu.description: One power supply unit reported for a server.

RaidCheck.title: RaidCheck
RaidCheck.description:
The collector's verdict on whether the server mirrors its OS disks (ADR-0048).

`state` is `PRESENT`, `ABSENT` (authoritative: the collector read every source it
trusts) or `UNKNOWN` (the BMC cannot say, e.g. software RAID). Only `ABSENT` is a fault.

ReleaseServerRequest.title: ReleaseServerRequest
ReleaseServerRequest.description:
The request body for releasing the install lock.

Both fields optional so a release with neither is an operator override —
ADR-0035, "Consequences".

Reservation.title: Reservation
Reservation.description:
The install-lock state embedded on a `Server` document.

Attributes:
    holder (str | None): What took the lock, e.g. "install-server".
    mce_cluster (str | None): The MCE cluster this server is being
        installed into. The field that makes the lock legible.
    infra_env (str | None): The InfraEnv being filled.
    namespace (str | None): Where the BareMetalHost is being created.
    workflow_id (str | None): The run holding it, for tracing back.
    created_at (datetime | None): When it was taken.
    expires_at (datetime | None): When it stops being honoured. None means
        a reservation that never expires, which `reserve` never writes.

ReservationFlag.title: ReservationFlag
ReservationFlag.description:
One inventory row's view of the install lock.

Whether it is held, and WHERE it is going — `mce_cluster` is why this
reaches the row at all. ADR-0035, decision 6.

ReserveServerRequest.title: ReserveServerRequest
ReserveServerRequest.description: The request body for taking the install lock on a server.

Role.title: Role

RuleFlagsSchema.title: RuleFlagsSchema
RuleFlagsSchema.description: The regex flags a classification rule's pattern is compiled with.

RuleScopeSchema.title: RuleScopeSchema
RuleScopeSchema.description: The vendor/manager-type/site a classification rule is restricted to.

RuleStatsSchema.title: RuleStatsSchema
RuleStatsSchema.description: A classification rule's accumulated timeout/quarantine counters.

ServerDetail.title: ServerDetail
ServerDetail.description:
Full server detail.

See the module docstring for why this is a dedicated model rather than
`Server` returned as-is.

ServerListResponse.title: ServerListResponse
ServerListResponse.description: One page of servers plus its paging metadata.

ServerRow.title: ServerRow
ServerRow.description:
One flat inventory row for `GET /servers/rows` (ADR-0033).

Only what the inventory table renders or searches on; the detail page
fetches the rest. Built from a Mongo projection, never from `Server`.

ServerRowsResponse.title: ServerRowsResponse
ServerRowsResponse.description: The whole fleet as inventory rows, plus when the inventory last changed.

ServerSummary.title: ServerSummary
ServerSummary.description:
List-response projection of a server.

Nested to match `ServerDetail`'s shape — one nesting convention across
both endpoints, not two.

SiteStats.title: SiteStats
SiteStats.description: One site's fleet-wide breakdown, sliced further by installation type.

SiteStatsListResponse.title: SiteStatsListResponse
SiteStatsListResponse.description: Every configured site's statistics, plus "Unassigned", plus the fleet-wide summary.

Storage.title: Storage
Storage.description: A server's aggregate storage capacity, its individual drives and its controllers.

StorageController.title: StorageController
StorageController.description: One storage controller and the virtual disks configured on it (ADR-0048).

StorageDrive.title: StorageDrive
StorageDrive.description: One storage drive reported for a server.

StorageVolume.title: StorageVolume
StorageVolume.description: One virtual disk a storage controller exposes.

UnreachableReason.title: UnreachableReason
UnreachableReason.description: Why a BMC could not be read, set with `reachable=False` (docs/adr/0037).

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description:
The vendors this platform ingests from; no `UNKNOWN`, by design (docs/adr/0011).

`STANDALONE` is a manufacturer this platform does not model, not
"collected without a manager" — see docs/adr/0016.

VendorCount.title: VendorCount
VendorCount.description: How many servers of one vendor a breakdown counts.
